channel.title: Product Diary
channel.description: What changed across the projects, day by day.

item.title: Insider Threat Assessment Tool — 2026-10-08
item.description: A website for rating how ready an organisation is for insider threats compiles again for the first time in over a year.

item.title: mac-bin — 2026-10-08
item.description: The tool that keeps Claude's skills in step across three Macs stopped treating its own backups as skills.

item.title: Prism Shift — 2026-10-08
item.description: All fifteen levels now have their own music, backdrops and layouts, and the music slides from one level into the next without stopping play.

item.title: QixForge — 2026-10-08
item.description: Every level got hand-built obstacles to claim around, and a slower or faster game pace can now be chosen in the options.

item.title: SecureWatch — 2026-10-08
item.description: The code history was cleared of nearly fifteen thousand leftover build files that were clogging every status check.

item.title: Prism Shift — 2026-10-07
item.description: Every scripted walkthrough of the whole game now passes on a small phone screen, three days before its planned release.

item.title: QixForge — 2026-10-07
item.description: The game's hardest level became finishable for ordinary players, and everything was fitted to the phone screen for release.

item.title: CyberSim — 2026-10-06
item.description: CyberSim got its App Store page written and its release paperwork set up, so version 1.1.0 can be sent to Apple.

item.title: Civic Fortune 2026 — 2026-10-05
item.description: Three of the game's five ways to win could never be won; they now can, and a run saves itself so you can quit and come back.

item.title: SnapDog — 2026-10-02
item.description: The recording focus fix is still unfinished, and the product site gained new pictures of the order page.

item.title: QixForge — 2026-10-01
item.description: All 100 levels were play-tested by a bot and rebalanced, and the game gained story scenes and per-sector music.

item.title: SnapDog — 2026-10-01
item.description: Arrows drawn leftward no longer flip, new captures open clean, and click rings in recordings land on the click.

item.title: SnapDog — 2026-09-30
item.description: Starting a screen recording no longer leaves SnapDog in front, so your first click lands in the app you are recording.

item.title: Lectern — 2026-09-29
item.description: Lectern can now find and download local AI models inside the app, and the main screens were reworked.

item.title: QixForge — 2026-09-29
item.description: QixForge now explains why you lost a life, plays properly sideways, and starts on a dark screen.

item.title: BookForge pipeline — 2026-09-28
item.description: The BookForge Mac app got a consistent look and stopped claiming a book had no chapters while it loaded.

item.title: StatBar — 2026-09-28
item.description: Building a release of the app no longer hangs forever waiting on Apple's security check.
